parameters.name: AttackType
parameters.description:
Attack type of the vulnerability protection event. Values:
- SQL injection
- Cross-site scripting
- Code execution
- CRLF
- Local file inclusion
- Remote file inclusion
- Webshell
- Cross-site request forgery
- Other
- SEMA

parameters.name: Language
parameters.description:
Language type, which will be used to return the response. Value range:

- **en**: English.
- **zh**: Chinese.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: Site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) interface.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa list-waf-managed-rules --site-id 1 --instance-id esa-site-awmmx25y2igw --id 10000001 --managed-ruleset '{"ProtectionLevel":-1,"Action":"monitor","ManagedRules":[{"Status":"on","Action":"js","Id":20611349}],"AttackType":11}' --attack-type 11 --protection-level 1 --biz-language zh --query-args Status_:_,_ProtectionLevels_:_2,1_,_Action_:_,_IdNameLike_: --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --region cn-hangzhou
